title: Workspace (workspace.yaml)
description: Optional. Names other project roots this orchestrator instance can also drive (T41) — a person checking several projects' status at once instead of remembering each --project-root by hand. Absence is not an error: a project with no workspace.yaml simply runs standalone, the same as before T41.

version.description: Schema generation of this file. Bumped only when a change would break an existing reader.

projects.description: Every project this workspace groups, including (optionally) this one.

name.description: Stable identifier for this project within the workspace — lower-case, unpunctuated, same shape as a module-folder name.

root.description: Path to the project's repo root, resolved relative to the directory holding this workspace.yaml — so a relative path like '../other-repo' works regardless of where the orchestrator is invoked from.
